recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the same defect appears in a current build, investigate the active publisher/Kindling implementation or the external SDC IG rather than changing retired core SDC source in this checkout.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core issue asking that the SDC profile table view show actual extension/profile names and suppress standard slicing rows for complex nested extensions instead of rendering generic 'extension' rows and question-mark profile names.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite SVN revision 3261. Git-svn commit a7d1aef4b7921db67adf4f508cfa51be96c232a4, '{#3674}: Fix rendering of complex extensions', is build@3261 and changed the old Java ProfileUtilities and PageProcessor table-rendering code to resolve nested extension elements, display the actual extension element name, and suppress standard extension slicing rows.
additional_context: The related SDC page questionnaire-sdc.structureddatacaptureform.html is not an active current-core build page: source/igs.xml comments out SDC and SDC-DE IG entries, current Questionnaire notes link to the external UV SDC IG, and the current build uses the external org.hl7.fhir:kindling dependency rather than carrying the historical Java renderer source. Community searches found no relevant later reversal or current conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The issue was applied historically, the specific SDC profile page is out of current core build scope, and the current checkout has no editable core source corresponding to the old renderer code fixed by the issue.
